_comment: Machine-readable per-file index for LLM retrieval. Snapshot 2026-06-20. Keep in sync with docs/codebase-overview.md when files are added/removed/moved. Generated artifacts carry a 'GENERATED by ...' banner and must not be hand-edited.

files.summary: Built bundle (~1.6 MB) powering the 3D mind-map pages. Do not reformat.
Vendored D3 v7 (~280 KB) powering the 2D page. Do not reformat.
Project overview, quick start, demo index, links to docs.
Rules for AI agents: don't hand-edit generated files, no invented build/test commands, treat binaries as opaque.
Repo-local agent catalog (none defined yet).
Gemini CLI notes; defers to CLAUDE.md.
How to contribute; generated-file and vendored-library ground rules.
Versioned work log; newest entry on top.
Chronological record of user requests.
Validates every tracked *.json file parses.
Client-side threat model (XSS via untrusted desc/link fields, vendored-lib provenance) and reporting.
System context, components, data flow, ADR-001..003.
Run demos via static server (pages load library via ../), JSON validation, troubleshooting.
Renderers + the source-tree, inlined-graph, and skills-graph JSON schemas.
Examples library paths (resolved, durable upstream fix pending), missing generators, count discrepancies, dangling edges, files removed during reorg.
Human-readable file-by-file map.
Root copy of the 3D mind map. Same as examples/concept-tree-3d.html but loads concept-tree-3d.bundle.js by a bare sibling path. Duplicated by design — see docs/known-issues.md #7.
Root copy of the 2D viz; loads d3.v7.min.js by a bare sibling path. Duplicate of examples/concept-tree.html.
Root copy of the skills graph; loads the 3D bundle by a bare sibling path. Duplicate of examples/skills-graph.html.
Root copy of the larger skills graph variant. Duplicate of examples/skills-graph-full.html.
Graph data (231 nodes / 800 links). Byte-identical to examples/skills-graph.json.
Larger skills-graph data variant. Byte-identical to examples/skills-graph-full.json.
3D force-directed mind map. Inlines const DATA {nodes,links}; loads ../concept-tree-3d.bundle.js. Search, layout modes, focus/isolate, details panel.
2D radial tree / treemap / charts via D3 (loads ../d3.v7.min.js).
Skills node-link graph rendered with the 3D bundle (loads ../concept-tree-3d.bundle.js).
Larger skills graph variant.
Concept-tree source data: array of {concept, skillId, parentConcept, childConcepts[], researchedAt, sourcesCount, conceptsCount}.
Graph data: {nodes[{id,name,isRoot,isGroup,color,val,group}], links[{source,target}]}. 231 nodes / 800 links.
Larger skills-graph data variant.
Static Markdown companion to the 2D viz; domain pie/flow Mermaid, count stats, dangling-edge notes.
Hierarchical Markdown map of concepts and backing skills.
Mermaid mindmap (backbone). Full leaf-expanded variant (tree-mindmap-full.mmd) was removed during reorg.
Original two-line project blurb, relocated into examples/ during the reorg.
